title: Crunchy Mars Bar Dessert
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert made with Mars bars, perfect for a quick treat.
instructions: Line an 8x8 inch baking dish with parchment paper.
Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over low heat.
Add the sugar and stir until dissolved.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract.
Add the broken Mars bars and crunchy bar to the saucepan, stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely before slicing into bars.
